budget.note: Scaffold cap for one 10-pair A/A (40 guests) plus comparison pairs and validity reruns. Per-case TCG wall time is not a measured envelope.

accelerator.kvm: run.py accepts KVM only when SWAP_NEXT_ACCEL=kvm. A revision 3 evaluation rejects any result whose accelerator is not tcg.

order: alternating AB then BA; same order in calibration

validity.host_load: loadavg and PSI when /proc/pressure exists, stored on every attempt

screen: TCG-only. A passing verdict is a screen for effects of roughly 15% or larger, up to about 25%. KVM confirmation is an open owner decision.

excluded.usemem-rand: OOM and synchronization hang in integration

purpose: QEMU TCG screen for swap-standard/xswap. Revisions 1 and 2 stay frozen.
measurement_revision: Noise envelope is the nearest-rank p90 of absolute pair ratios over at least 10 A/A pairs (the 9th of 10 ordered values, so one extreme pair is outside the envelope). Scored ceiling is 25%. Metrics whose names end in .p99_ns are advisory: they are reported and do not reject calibration or a regression guard. Comparison is at least 4 AB/BA pairs per backend, judged on the median pair delta. The TCG guest is 4 vCPU and 4096 MiB with a 16 GiB preallocated scratch swap image.
ceiling_justification: Under revision 2 the TCG A/A (2560 MiB guests) was CALIBRATION_NOISY. Pair-median spreads were 4-10% and worst-pair tails were 19-28%. One pair reported TSC unstable, fell back to HPET, and produced large wall-time outliers. At 2560 MiB, zswap wrote back to disk (zswpwb about 24k, 16-17% of faults), which the KVM runs did not do. The 25% ceiling is the bottom of the approved 25-30% band and matches a screen for effects of roughly 15-25%. A 30% ceiling on every metric would treat a p99 tail as if it were the effect size this screen can resolve. p99 stays advisory so a 19-28% p99 tail does not fail the tier by itself. A scored mean or primary metric whose p90 still exceeds 25% stays CALIBRATION_NOISY. Confidence in the 25% split is medium: the published summary gives ranges, not a per-metric p90. A per-metric p90 from the revision 2 pairs that sits above 25% on a scored mean metric would move the ceiling inside the approved band or keep that metric advisory.
limitations: Verdicts are TCG-only screens for effects of roughly 15-25% or larger. KVM confirmation is an open owner decision.
p99 latency is advisory under this revision.
The 25% ceiling is a gate, not the measured p90. Calibration still has to pass on a fresh revision 3 A/A before any candidate comparison.
Guest wall time per case is unmeasured. guest_timeout 900 and wall_seconds 64800 are scaffold caps.
4096 MiB is the revision 3 guest size because 2560 MiB spilled zswap to disk. This file does not re-measure that spill.
A pre-launch stall above 60 seconds, including swap-image preallocation, invalidates the attempt. Repeated stalls exhaust the two reruns and fail the tier.
The wall-time gate starts after three prior valid wall times for that case. The first three valid runs of a case are not wall outliers.
No slow tier. eligible_for_slow in a fast result does not authorize a slow run.
auxiliary_budget: Correctness guests and builds reserve from this protocol's own state budget before launch. Revision 2's ledger is a different state directory and stays untouched. All failures are retained.
